timing: One deterministic warmed full encode/decode per setting, alternating source/candidate order. Ordinary/hybrid/base-only timers include common prepare, base encode/decode, owned heads/model load, all fresh refinement, serialization/entropy and enabled true-source internal MSE. JPEG encode excludes the separately shared ordinary prepare and is not a full speed comparison. Decoders include final RGB/resize. IO/hash/external scoring excluded.
